note: Machine-readable known-red set for `pnpm lint` on this fork, used by `local/gate-lint.mjs`.
A failing step or failure line listed here is reported but does not fail the gate; one outside
it does. Same shape as `local/unit-known-red.json`, which gates the unit suite.
An entry is a claim that a red is not this branch's to fix: it arrives through a merge of someone
else's work, or it is a fork-owned file upstream will rename out from under the fix. Record the
evidence in LOCAL-PATCHES.md and keep this file the assertion — both change in the same commit.
No entry belongs here merely because the fix is inconvenient.
`step` is the package.json script name (or the literal command, for a bare `oxlint` step).
`match` is an optional regex against one failure line. The ratchets print one `::error::` line or
one `file: N unit(s), baseline allows M.` row per offending entry, so a narrow regex allowlists
that entry alone. An entry with no `match` allowlists the whole step, which is the coarse option —
prefer `match` for a ratchet, because a whole-step entry also masks a NEW failure in that step.
A step that prints `::error file=X::text` is matched as `X: text`, so an entry can name one file;
the text alone is the same for every file those ratchets report.
Only a whole-step entry can cover a step whose failure the parser could not split into lines.
Keeping entries: documented in LOCAL-PATCHES.md => keep even when a run reproduces nothing
(the machine state varies). Observed once and undocumented => prune it. An entry that stops
reproducing is reported stale; `node local/gate-lint.mjs --prune` drops it.
